prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone sign-in until after pet adoption: Move sign-in step to occur after pet creation and adoption certificate completion, so users build emotional commitment before creating an account. (why: 8 support emails mentioned lost pets on sign-in, and sign-in drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning before they experience pet customization.)
1: [home, redesign] Interactive Playground Loading Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic mini pet playground stage with real-time tips and progress milestone tracking. (why: The waiting step has the longest friction in the onboarding flow (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing users to abandon before reaching home.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Protection and Cloud Sync Sign-in Hint: Display explicit account recovery and cloud backup warning card on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [finish, layout] Desktop Summon Action Banner: Re-layout home_intro screen into a centered callout card with a prominent 'Summon Pet to Desktop' action button. (why: 3 support tickets noted that pet does not appear on desktop or users do not know how to bring it up after setup.)
4: [home, notification] Background Notification System for Generation: Add option to get notified when pet creation finishes so users can safely minimize the app during long waits. (why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s mean time, leading to desktop app stall support tickets.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Onboarding Story Copy: Update story intro text with concise, welcoming language and realistic time expectation. (why: Total onboarding completion is only 17.8%, requiring clearer expectations from the first screen.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in after pet adoption creates emotional commitment and addresses major support complaints.
Interactive waiting screens mitigate extreme wait times (200s+ median) before home.
Low cost hint addition directly backed by 8 support tickets.
Prominent action button helps recover 35.2% drop-off at final onboarding step.
Background notifications solve app abandonments during long pet generation process.
Config-only copy optimization for initial step with modest potential lift.
